name: FICTIONAL TEST FIXTURE: Example Joint Master in Data Science
text:
# About the programme
This two-year master is taught in English in three countries. Students spend one semester in each partner university.

# Eligibility requirements
Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. Applicants need a CGPA of at least 3.0 on a 4.0 scale. Applicants must have completed 16 years of education. Applicants must be under 35 years of age on the deadline. An IELTS score of 6.5 is required.

# Selection
Shortlisted candidates are invited to an interview.

# Deadline
Applications close on 15 January 2027.

name: FICTIONAL TEST FIXTURE: Example Government Scholarship
text:
# Overview
The scholarship covers tuition and a monthly stipend.

# Who can apply
Candidates need a CGPA of 2.5 or higher. An IELTS overall 6.0 is required for English-taught courses. Candidates must be under 30 years old.

# Process
All eligible candidates sit an interview at the embassy.
